preamble: Debuccalization of the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ] to the glottal fricative [h] removes the lateral tongue constriction and keeps only voiceless glottal friction. It is a regular change in Buduma, the only language of the Kotoko Island group of Central Chadic, which shows h wherever the rest of the North sub-branch keeps Proto-Central Chadic *ɬ; Buduma also turned *s into h.

examples.note: Kotoko North and Kotoko Centre keep ɬa.
Kotoko North has ɬɨm, Kotoko Centre ɬɨmi.

sources: Gravina, R. (2014). The Phonology of Proto-Central Chadic: The Reconstruction of the Phonology and Lexicon of Proto-Central Chadic, and the Linguistic History of the Central Chadic Languages. https://www.lotpublications.nl/Documents/375_fulltext.pdf
